svg.text: Base: two rails 940 long, 270 apart (centres), and two cross

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tubes 245 between them at the ends, welded flat on the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: four strips of 18 mm marine plywood, 80 wide; the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 772 long, the back two 786 long (the deck slopes 3 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the front); cut the tops to that slope.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs stand on the rails 40 and 900 from the head end of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base, thin side toward the head, so they flex along the table.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleats: eight 80 mm pieces of 40 x 40 x 4 angle, two M8 bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the leg and two into the rail or the deck underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tilt: packers under the top cleats set 2 to 4 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: push the deck along by hand; it swings freely 10 mm each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: way and springs back to centre.
